product_overview: MedConnect Hub is a role-aware healthcare coordination portal that connects clinic staff, hospital teams, and administrators to create, route, and track patient referrals and case work. The high-level product goals and workflows are documented in the product specification (see pages 1-4 of the PRD, including diagrams and lists of core features).
core_goals: Allow users to sign in and land in a role-specific portal so they can pick up relevant work immediately.
Enable clinic users to create, list, and update patient referrals and communicate status to hospital teams.
Enable hospital staff to triage incoming referrals, manage assigned cases, and provide feedback to clinics.
Allow administrators to manage users, approve accounts, assign roles, and audit activity across organizations.
Provide in-app messaging between clinic and hospital users to coordinate case updates and follow-ups.

features.name: Portal Authentication
features.description: Users sign in with an identifier and password and are routed to the portal appropriate for their role (clinic, hospital, or admin).
user_flows: Navigate to /auth -> Enter email or username in the identifier field -> Enter password and optionally toggle visibility -> Submit the sign-in form -> Land in role-specific portal via /portal
Navigate to /auth -> Enter email or username in the identifier field -> Enter incorrect password -> Submit the sign-in form -> See validation error indicating credentials are invalid

features.name: Clinic Referral Management
features.description: Clinic users create new patient referrals, view their referral list, and exchange messages with hospital teams about referral status.
user_flows: Navigate to /clinic -> Open the referral listing at /clinic/referrals -> Start a new referral by navigating to /clinic/referrals/new -> Fill out the referral information -> Submit the referral form -> Return to /clinic/referrals and see the new referral listed

Navigate to /clinic -> Open the referral listing at /clinic/referrals -> Select a referral from the list to review its details -> Navigate to /clinic/messages -> Send an update message about the referral -> Observe the message in the conversation thread
Navigate to /clinic -> Navigate to /clinic/referrals/new -> Attempt to submit the referral form with required fields missing -> See inline validation errors for the missing fields

features.name: Hospital Case Processing
features.description: Hospital staff review incoming referrals, open and review referral contents, assign or accept cases, track assigned cases, and coordinate feedback to clinics.
user_flows: Navigate to /hospital -> Open incoming referrals at /hospital/inbox -> Open an incoming referral from the list -> Review referral details and attachments shown on screen -> Assign the referral to yourself or a team member -> Navigate to /hospital/assigned -> See the case listed under assigned cases
Navigate to /hospital -> Navigate to /hospital/feedback -> Select a case to provide feedback -> Enter feedback and save -> Navigate to /hospital/messages -> Send a message to the clinic with feedback

features.name: Administrative Oversight
features.description: Administrators browse admin modules, approve new users, configure roles and organizations, and review audit logs for governance.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin -> Browse admin modules on the admin landing page -> Navigate to /admin/approvals -> Review pending approvals and approve a user -> Navigate to /admin/users -> Confirm the approved user appears in the user list
Navigate to /admin -> Navigate to /admin/roles -> Select a user or role to update permissions -> Save role changes -> Navigate to /admin/audit -> Review recent audit entries related to the change
Navigate to /admin -> Navigate to /admin/clinics -> Open a clinic record from the list -> Update clinic metadata and save -> Navigate to /admin/hospitals -> Confirm corresponding hospital entries
